name: Button Hover Bounce
description: Natural bounce effect for UI elements when hovered or activated.
code: n = 0; if (numKeys > 0){ n = nearestKey(time).index; if (key(n).time > time){ n--; } } if (n == 0){ t = 0; }else{ t = time - key(n).time; } if (n > 0){ v = velocityAtTime(key(n).time - thisComp.frameDuration/10); amp = {{amplitude}}; freq = {{frequency}}; decay = {{decay}}; value + v*amp*Math.sin(freq*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(decay*t); }else{ value; }
